messages:
Maya (EventOps): Heads-up — checklist for Thursday webinar (Redwood Optimize launch). Need: registration page, Zoom config (webinar vs meeting), recording plan, post-event follow-up + lead routing. I’ll own producer role. Test run Wed 10:00am PT. Anyone blocked?

Raj (Growth): HubSpot form + landing page preferred, so submissions land straight in CRM. We should capture UTM params + job title.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Agree HubSpot. Suggest the landing copy focus on cost-per-token improvements and a short benchmark teaser. Also want a clear CTA to book a demo in the follow-up.

Diego (Sales Ops): For lead routing, map HubSpot fields to SDR queues: 
- company_size (number)
- job_title (text)
- intent_score (number)
Map logic: company_size >= 50 OR intent_score >= 70 => assign to AE queue, else to SDR nurture.

Maya (EventOps): Zoom license — we have a Webinar license for up to 1k attendees. I’ll create session and enable cloud recording + enable practice session. ZoomBot: "Meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/999999999?pwd=XXXXX (Webinar), ID: 999 999 999, Passcode: redwood"

Sam (Prod Marketing): Can we enable Q&A and polling? Also plan 1 native poll at 20 mins to boost engagement.

Maya (EventOps): Q&A & polling enabled. Producer role = me. Need one tech run for panelists Wed 10am PT.

Alice (Content): Draft confirmation email and reminder copy — will share templates. Schedule: immediate confirmation, 24h reminder, 1h reminder, 10m pre-start push. Follow-up email with recording + transcript + CTA.

Raj (Growth): UTM scheme: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=redwood_optimize_q2. Add hidden fields on the form for utm_source/medium/campaign.

Diego (Sales Ops): Zapier flow suggestion (one-liner): New HubSpot form submission -> create contact -> trigger workflow -> set owner if match criteria -> create task for SDR.

Diego (Sales Ops): Example Zapier filter (copy-paste):
```
Trigger: New Form Submission (HubSpot)
Filter: (company_size >= 50) OR (intent_score >= 70)
Action: Update Contact -> Assign owner=AE_queue_id
```

Maya (EventOps): Recording plan: cloud recording (speaker view) + ask presenter to record local as backup. Save cloud recording to Marketing GDrive path: drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_marketing/Webinars/2026-03-26_Redwood_Optimize

Sam (Prod Marketing): I’ll record local backup on my laptop and upload immediately after. Also will capture slides as PDF for follow-up.

Alice (Content): Post-event follow-up cadence: 1) Recording + slides (same day), 2) Highlights + CTA (3 days), 3) Nurture snippet (2 weeks). Include transcript & time-stamped highlights for top questions.

Raj (Growth): For inbound scoring, add rule: form_submitted AND (company_size > 50 OR job_title contains "engineer|platform|ml") => increase intent_score +20.

Maya (EventOps): Panelist join links: send private panelist link + calendar invite with rehearsal time. Panelists: Sam (host), Raj (growth), Dina (research) — Sam please confirm Dina.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Confirmed Dina. Will send slides by Tue EOD.

Diego (Sales Ops): Quick ask re: HubSpot props — can you create a hidden "webinar_topic" property and a dropdown "interest_level" so we can segment post-event?

Raj (Growth): Also want a webhook to the ABM tool for accounts > 200 employees so account team gets notified. Diego can you own?

Diego (Sales Ops): Yep, will add webhook rule.

Maya (EventOps): Checklist summary (short):
- HubSpot landing + form (Alice/Raj)
- Zoom Webinar created + cloud recording (Maya)
- Practice session Wed 10am PT (all panelists)
- Zapier mapping -> HubSpot owner assignment (Diego)
- Local recorder & slides (Sam)
- Follow-up email templates (Alice)

Sam (Prod Marketing): Quick note: record native Zoom transcript and attach to email; make sure transcript is cleaned before sending.

Alice (Content): Will prepare 2 follow-up variants: "Recording + book demo" and "Recording + whitepaper" to A/B test subject lines.

Maya (EventOps): Final ops question — enable attendee registration approval? We should keep it open registration, but blacklist disposable emails via simple regex. Opinions?

Raj (Growth): Open registration for reach. We'll filter bad emails server-side.

Diego (Sales Ops): One last item: add a field "source_detail" for the form so we can route leads from partner promos separately.

Maya (EventOps): All right — action items assigned. I’ll drop the rehearsal invite and the Zoom panelist links by EOD. :thumbsup: :rocket:

Sam (Prod Marketing): :eyes: will prep slides and local recording checklist.

ZoomBot: Recording setting: Cloud recording (active speaker + gallery), auto-transcribe ON, recording access: restricted to hosts + marketing@redwood.com."
